posts.title: Testing Clef Decision Models as a Content Filter
posts.description: I spent four days running Cloudflare's Clef-Flash decision model on a laptop GPU to filter sensitive questions out of a four-million-row dataset. I compared serving engines and ways of asking, and about 650,000 requests showed how much a decision model's answers depend on wording and on the questions asked alongside them.

posts.title: Testing Blender Scenes Built by LLM Agents
posts.description: An agent building a Blender scene can't see the viewport, so every claim it makes about clipping, contact, scale or motion has to be measured. These are the twelve families of checks from a 640-frame mech film a team of Claude agents built in bpy, plus the three times the checks themselves were wrong.

posts.title: How Claude Code's Projects Beta Works Under the Hood
posts.description: A project is a channel, a thread is a message, and the Claude doing work on your machine is a child of a cloud session you never see. A full walkthrough of the Projects beta, from the channels API down to the process the desktop app spawns in your folder.
